title: Create: Aeronautica SMP
description: This is the modpack used on the the Create: Aeronuatica SMP.
body:
This modpack was created for the sole purpose of easier distribution to other players on the server I run, Aeronautica SMP. It features a selection of Create Mod related addons, and even some addons to those addons, as well as various other QOL and technology mods such as Mekanism. This pack has been trimmed down from my personal modpack with client-side mods, so there may still be some remnants of client-side mods, but for the most part, all mods in this pack are required to be run server-side and client-side. Enjoy and remember, The Sky Belongs to the Bold! (ChatGPT logo for the server follows :))
![This logo is of a flying airship in a very steampunk format. It features two text areas, one saying "Aeronautica SMP", and the other below that saying "The Sky Belongs to the Bold"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd04ffe5d60a0f7fe25d2689d67274444e504284.png)

Yes, I'm aware that there's no mention of this server anywhere except here; it's just for my friends and I.
